reviews.text: Wants ALL your data including cookies for 10+ years
reviews.reply: Hi John, sorry for the inconvenience. We only request mic and storage permissions for basic recording and saving. No user info is collected. The cookie preferences you encountered may be due to ads within the app. It's required for privacy compliance. We will work on improving our app for a better user experience. Best regards!🌹

Hi dear user, we are sorry for not meeting your expectations. We'd love to help. Could you please provide more details about the problem you encountered?😊 We will locate the issue and solve it as soon as possible. Have a nice day.🌹

reviews.text: I bought a one year subscription days ago but when I opened it today it's back to normal with ads 👎🏽
reviews.reply: Hi Damian, sorry for the trouble. Please make sure you're logged into the account used for the purchase on the Play Store. If you have multiple accounts logged in the Play Store, sign out of all and log back into the subscription one. If the issue persists, please send us screenshots of your order via "Settings - Help & Feedback".🌹

reviews.text: This app has too many ads to be even remotely usable. The app would be probably fine if the ads were toned down but until then 1 star!
reviews.reply: Hi Mike, sorry for the ads. We'll improve the app and minimize ads for a smoother experience. Since our app is free, ads support its survival and improvement. If preferred, you may consider purchasing the Pro version to remove ads. Sincerely!🌹

reviews.text: Horrid app... you can't save any recordings cause of the Continuly Pop Up Spams... !!!
reviews.reply: Hi Erx, sorry for the experience. Saved recordings can be found in the Recording List after you tap save. We understand the ads may be disruptive and will work on reducing them. You can also choose the Pro version to remove ads. If you still have issues, please send us details via "Settings - Feedback". Sincerely!🌹

reviews.text: Horrible app, they intentionally make it impossible to exit. Way too much advertisement pop-ups on the way out.
reviews.reply: Hi Hau, apologies for the ads. As a free app, we rely on them to support and enhance our products. We're actively working to make them less intrusive. Additionally, you may consider opting for our premium version to enjoy an ad-free experience. Best regards.❤️

reviews.text: full screen ad with fake x to close, have to kill the app to get the ad off the screen

Ads help keep the app free. We're actively working to make them less intrusive. Additionally, you may opt for our premium version to enjoy an ad-free experience.❤️

reviews.text: Live transcribe is behind a wall, when you could use somejing else that already transcribes...
reviews.reply: Hi dear user, sorry for the trouble. Live transcription requires significant processing resources and ongoing maintenance, including speech recognition services and cloud processing costs, which is why it is provided as a paid feature. This helps us continue to improve accuracy and add new features. We appreciate your understanding and support.❤️
